It's small, uninhabited; the perfect place for a skirmish.|Jarek Yeager briefs Ace Squadron|audio=YeagerIceMoon-LiveFire.flac|}} '''Celsor 3''' was an [[Water|ice]] [[moon]] located in the [[Celsor system]] of the [[Hook Nebula]]. Its primary terrain was snow-topped ice pillars and icy ground. It was uninhabited, save for the native [[jakoosk]]s, who spent most of their [[time]] [[Sleep|slumbering]]. The moon was visited by the inhabitants of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' in [[34 ABY]]. Running from the [[First Order military|militant]] [[First Order]] and looking for [[Foodstuff|food]], the resident [[Warbird gang]] disembarked from the ''Colossus'' to [[Mission to Celsor 3|hunt]] a local jakoosk as a source of food for the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]]. Though the [[Hunting|hunt]] proved unsuccessful, the [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[pilot]] [[Torra Doza]] later returned to the moon and managed to [[Death|kill]] the beast. ==Description== {{Quote|All right, what's the plan, Hype?"
"Our target's not gonna be the creature. It's gonna be the ice pillars."
"Ooh, that's brilliant.|Kazuda Xiono and Hype Fazon discuss their plan of attack|audio=ItsGonnaBeTheIcePillars-LiveFire.flac|}} The small [[moon]] Celsor 3 was located in the [[Hook Nebula]]'s [[Celsor system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Trailing Sectors]] of [[the galaxy]]. The uninhabited, terrestrial moon was situated in grid square O-17 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]] and had a breathable, Type I [[atmosphere]]. It also featured a picturesque landscape covered in [[Water|ice]] and snow and dotted with giant ice pillars blanketed in fog. A foreboding and unwelcoming place, the only creature known to survive on the [[Temperature|frigid]], inhospitable moon was the [[jakoosk]], a massive flying beast that remained in [[Sleep|slumber]] until unsuspecting visitors disturbed it and whose meat was consumed across the galaxy.''[[Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy]]'' ==History== {{Quote|Aunt Z told us if we catch that jakoosk, she can cook it for the entire platform.|Torra Doza, to Imanuel Doza|audio=TorraAuntZJakoosk-HuntOnCelsor3.flac|}} [[File:JakooskSplash-LiveFire.jpg|thumb|right|240px|The Warbirds attempt to kill a massive jakoosk.]] After [[Skirmish over D'Qar|escaping]] the [[First Order military|militant]] [[First Order]] over the [[Planet|world]] [[D'Qar]]{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} in [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|2|3}} the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' passed near Celsor 3. [[New Republic]] veteran [[Jarek Yeager]] chose the moon as a location for training exercises after being placed in command of [[Ace Squadron]], the [[Supertanker fuel depot|platform's]] main defenders. In their first excursion to the moon, Yeager and the Ace Squadron [[pilot]] and [[Resistance]] [[spy]] [[Kazuda Xiono]] worked together to take out the rest of Aces. During another of their training exercises on the moon, the Aces were attacked by a jakoosk awakened by their flying through the moon's ice pillars, and Yeager was nearly eaten before the Aces shook his [[Jarek Yeager's racer|starfighter]] free by shooting one of the pillars so it collapsed onto the creature. Not long afterward, the [[Warbird gang]]'s leader, [[Kragan Gorr]], saw an opportunity to undermine the authority of the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[captain]], [[Imanuel Doza]]. The [[pirate]]s of the Warbird gang traveled to Celsor 3 in an attempt to [[Mission to Celsor 3|hunt]] the jakoosk for its meat, as the ''Colossus'' had run out of [[Foodstuff|food]]. However, the pirates were unprepared for the size of the creature and were eventually forced to retreat after losing two [[Starship|ships]]. [[File:HuntOnCelsor3-EpisodeGuide.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Kazuda Xiono aiming a blaster cannon at a jakoosk on Celsor 3.]] Xiono and the Ace Squadron pilot [[Torra Doza]], daughter of the captain, who had been monitoring the pirates, decided to return to Celsor 3 shortly thereafter and try to [[Hunting|hunt]] the creature themselves. The pair positioned a [[blaster cannon]] on the ground to shoot the jakoosk in its vulnerable belly. Despite some problems caused by Torra's pet, [[Buggles]], stowing away in their ship, the ''[[Fireball]]'', and interference from the stranded pirates [[Snarl]] and [[Drell]], Xiono and Torra's mission was successful, resulting in the [[death]] of the jakoosk and leaving the ''Colossus'' with enough food supplies to feed the entire platform for quite some [[time]]. After the [[Battle of Exegol|defeat]] of the [[Cloning|clone]] of [[Darth Sidious]] in [[35 ABY]],{{BestiaryVol1Date}} the creature enthusiast [[Ardis San Tekka]] mentioned Celsor 3 in her entry on jakoosks within her [[Ardis San Tekka's journal|journal]], which detailed her adventures seeing [[Sentience|non-sentient]] creatures throughout the galaxy with her [[droid]] companion, [[B8-T5]]. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Celsor3-ConceptArt.png|thumb|right|230px|Celsor 3 concept art]] Celsor 3 first appeared in "[[Live Fire]]," the third episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[October 20]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} The moon was was initially pictured, however, in the season's trailer, which was released on [[August 14]], 2019.{{SWYouTube|JkJtdJKCVto|Star Wars Resistance Season 2 - Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/disneyxd-season-2-trailer-star-wars-resistance}} It was first named by the title of the following episode, "[[Hunt on Celsor 3]]," which aired on [[October 27]], 2019. Concept art for the ice moon's depiction in "Live Fire" was done by [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artists [[Jim Moore]]{{SW|url=live-art-concept-art-gallery|text="Live Fire" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}} and [[Andre Kirk]]{{SW|url=live-art-concept-art-gallery|text="Live Fire" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}} on [[January 10]], 2018, and [[January 12]], 2018, respectively. [[Colas Gauthier]] drew concept artwork of Celsor 3's landscape for the following episode.{{SW|url=hunt-on-celsor-3-concept-art-gallery|text="Hunt on Celsor 3" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 1}} The episode guide for "Live Fire" mistakenly referred to Celsor 3 as a planet.{{SW|url=live-fire-episode-gallery|text="Live Fire" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 9}} ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:Celsor3-ConceptArt.png|Ice moon forest, J.
